children: Overview
France biotech firm's H1 2026 operating income declined yr/yr, mainly due to lower research tax credit
Net loss for H1 2026 narrowed compared to prior year
Company ended H1 2026 with €92.8 mln in cash, funded until early 2028
Outlook
Transgene expects topline results from TG4050 Phase 2 trial by end of Q1 2028
Company anticipates first immunological data from TG4050 Phase 2 in H2 2026
Transgene says it has sufficient cash to fund operations until early 2028
Result Drivers
PIPELINE PROGRESS - Co said publication of TG4050 Phase 1 data, completion of Phase 2 randomization, and initiation of TG4070 Phase 1 trial were key operational milestones
MANUFACTURING ADVANCES - Co said cell-line based manufacturing and proprietary AI tools support scalability and precision in vaccine development
